title: The wholesale distribution demo
body: This one is a demonstration, not a production system. I built a working revenue-operations environment for wholesale distribution technology, an industry I do not work in, to show that the same approach works outside my own company. It covers three scenarios: detecting which ERP a prospect runs before the first call, quantifying proof-of-value trials, and catching the buying window that opens after a private-equity acquisition. The data is seeded and fictional. The Postgres schema, the pipelines, and the scoring code are real and run live on this site.
